Hero.title:
The right home,
built around your life.
Hero.description: Explore and compare homes around the places that matter and the rhythm of your day — whether you start with MADAR or a listing you found elsewhere.
Hero.previewTitle: Every option, in the context of your life
Hero.mockNote: Illustrative preview — times are not live results

PropertyDiscovery.title: More than one way to find a home.
PropertyDiscovery.description: Search within MADAR or add a listing link that caught your eye. Choose the path that suits you and take it from there.
PropertyDiscovery.searchDescription: Start with a city, neighborhood and budget that fit.
PropertyDiscovery.linkDescription: Add its link from any property site and keep it for comparison.
PropertyDiscovery.demoNote: Demo interface — no search will be sent or link saved.
PropertyDiscovery.cityHint: Choose a city to continue to live results and advanced filters.
PropertyDiscovery.searchUnavailableDescription: No live listing search has been performed. Adjust your choices or continue to organize your saved property references.
PropertyDiscovery.cityRequiredHint: Choose a city before continuing your search.
PropertyDiscovery.referenceDescription: Keep its reference in your existing shortlist, then compare it with your other options.

PersonalizedLocations.eyebrow: Home, in the context of your day
PersonalizedLocations.title: It’s not just where you live. It’s how you live.
PersonalizedLocations.description: Add the places that shape your day if you like. They help you see each option from a perspective that fits your needs.
PersonalizedLocations.optionalNote: Personalization is optional — explore first and add details whenever you like.
PersonalizedLocations.sampleOnly: Sample locations and times for display
PersonalizedLocations.mapImageAlt: Illustrative isometric neighborhood showing a home connected to work, school and everyday destinations.

PropertyComparison.title: Compare what matters to you.
PropertyComparison.description: One view helps you weigh rent, location and the details of your day.
PropertyComparison.mockNote: All properties, prices and commute times in this comparison are illustrative only.
PropertyComparison.scrollComparison: Property comparison table; scroll horizontally to view all options
PropertyComparison.imageAltOne: Illustrative modern apartment building in a Riyadh neighborhood.
PropertyComparison.imageAltTwo: Illustrative contemporary villa with a landscaped entry.
PropertyComparison.imageAltThree: Illustrative upscale apartment residence at sunset.

HowItWorks.title: A clear path, with room for your choices.
HowItWorks.description: Use what helps and skip what you don’t need. MADAR adapts to how you search.
HowItWorks.stepOneDescription: Search within MADAR or add a listing link from another site.
HowItWorks.stepTwoTitle: Add what matters, if you like
HowItWorks.stepTwoDescription: Workplaces, schools and everyday destinations bring the comparison closer to real life.
HowItWorks.stepThreeDescription: Weigh your options clearly, around your own priorities.

Features.title: More than a list of homes.
Features.description: A concept for connecting housing options with the details of everyday life.
Features.flexibleDescription: Start with an internal search or a listing you found elsewhere.
Features.externalDescription: Keep your options together in one comparison experience.
Features.lifestyleDescription: Bring rent and everyday places into the same picture.
Features.locationsDescription: Organize places your way, and add or change them whenever you choose.
Features.compareDescription: See key differences without jumping between pages.
Features.insightsDescription: Clear information supports your decision; the choice is always yours.
Features.demoNote: This page presents an early demo concept for MADAR.

CTA.eyebrow: Choosing a home deserves a wider view
CTA.title: A better perspective on where to live.
CTA.description: Start exploring in the way that suits you, then take the time you need to compare.
CTA.note: You can explore before adding any personal places.

Footer.description: MADAR helps you see housing options in the context of the life you want to live.
Footer.demoDisclaimer: This demo does not show live property data.

Product.accountUnavailable: Account access is not available yet
Product.eyebrow: A clearer way to choose a home
Product.welcomeTitle: A home decision should start with your life.
Product.welcomeDescription: MADAR is being prepared to help you explore homes, bring listings you find elsewhere, and weigh the places that shape your day.
Product.discoveryTitle: Explore homes with the full picture in mind.
Product.discoveryDescription: Search homes in MADAR or bring a listing link from another site. Live property search and listing import are not available in the current backend yet.
Product.accessUnavailableTitle: Personal account features are not open yet
Product.accessUnavailableDescription: MADAR’s current backend does not provide secure sign-in or identity-bound access. Personal data features remain unavailable until that foundation is ready.
Product.searchUnavailableTitle: Live property discovery is not connected yet
Product.searchUnavailableDescription: The backend currently has no property search, details, or external listing import endpoint. This page will not show sample listings or pretend a search succeeded.
Product.journeyDiscovery: Start with a home you find through MADAR or bring a listing you already have in mind.
Product.journeyPersonalize: Add important places only if they help you judge how a home fits your routine.
Product.journeyCompare: Compare available details before making a decision, with clear context about what is known.
Product.accountSafetyDescription: The current service does not securely verify account ownership. We are keeping account-specific actions closed rather than exposing personal data or asking you to reuse a password.

Auth.signInIntro: Sign-in will let you keep your saved homes and the places that matter to you together.
Auth.registerIntro: Create an account when secure registration and account access are ready.
Auth.safeAccessTitle: We can’t accept credentials safely yet
Auth.signInUnavailable: There is no supported sign-in or session endpoint in the current backend.
Auth.registerUnavailable: The existing registration endpoint stores passwords without hashing and returns only a message, not a user ID or signed-in session. Registration is intentionally disabled until this is fixed.
Auth.noCredentialsNote: No password or personal account information is submitted or stored on this page.

Workspace.developmentAccessHint: For local testing only. Enter an existing test account ID supplied by your backend developer. This loads that account; it does not verify identity.
Workspace.authIntro: Keep the homes and places that matter to you together.
Workspace.authQuote: A home that fits your everyday life.
Workspace.needAccount: New to MADAR? Create an account
Workspace.registeredNoId: Your account was created. The backend did not return your user ID, so automatic access could not be completed. Ask your backend developer for the test account ID, then use development access.
Workspace.loginGap: The current backend has no email/password login operation. Your credentials were not submitted or verified. Use a known test account through development access for this local build.
Workspace.backendUnavailable: Cannot reach MADAR right now. Check the backend connection and try again.
Workspace.featureUnavailable: This service is not available in this environment.
Workspace.requestTimedOut: This request took too long. Try again.
Workspace.requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Check your information and try again.
Workspace.emailTaken: This email is already registered. Use a different email.
Workspace.userMissing: This account could not be found.
Workspace.duplicateSaved: This property is already in your shortlist.
Workspace.duplicateComparison: You have already saved this comparison.
Workspace.duplicateHome: You already have a current home. Refresh to edit it.
Workspace.duplicatePreference: You already have housing preferences. Refresh to edit them.
Workspace.deleteDescription: This change will be saved to your account and cannot be undone.
Workspace.passwordHint: 8–64 characters with uppercase and lowercase letters, a number and a special character. No spaces.
Workspace.placeTypeHint: For example: work, school or family.
Workspace.importanceHint: Choose a whole number from 1 (low) to 5 (high).
Workspace.savedIntro: Keep listing references in one place and choose the homes you want to consider together.
Workspace.noSavedHint: Save a listing reference using its source and listing number. Give it a title so it is easy to recognize.
Workspace.referenceHint: Enter the listing source and its reference number. This saves a reference; it does not import or extract a listing URL.
Workspace.propertyMissing: This saved property was not found
Workspace.propertyMissingHint: It may have been removed. Return to your shortlist to choose another home.
Workspace.referenceDetailsHint: Your saved title and reference are shown here. Live photos, prices and property facts require a listing detail API.
Workspace.locationsTitle: The places in your everyday life
Workspace.locationsIntro: Add destinations you visit regularly. Locations are optional; you can manage your shortlist without adding any.
Workspace.noLocations: Make room for your everyday places
Workspace.noLocationsHint: Add your workplace, school or another destination when you are ready.
Workspace.coordinateHint: Enter the real coordinates of your destination. Place search and travel calculations are not provided by the current backend.
Workspace.homeIntro: Save your home coordinates and, optionally, its listing reference and move-in date.
Workspace.housingIntro: Save the area, budget and property type you have in mind.
Workspace.profileIntro: The current account update requires a password along with your name and email. Use test credentials for this development build.
Workspace.deleteAccountHint: Permanently remove this account and its owned data. This cannot be undone.
Workspace.comparisonIntro: Choose two saved references and keep the pair for your decision.
Workspace.needTwoPropertiesHint: Save at least two distinct listing references, then return here to create a comparison pair.
Workspace.noComparisonsHint: Choose two saved homes in the form to create your first pair.
Workspace.referenceComparisonHint: This pair contains saved references. Price, commute and suitability analysis need backend listing and analysis services.
Workspace.dashboardIntro: A little closer to your next home. Pick up your shortlist, refine your preferences or add a place that matters.
Workspace.savedSummary: Your own shortlist of property references.
Workspace.locationsSummary: Destinations that matter to your daily life.
Workspace.compareSummary: Saved pairs you are considering together.
Workspace.dailyLifeHint: Adding your regular destinations is optional. Keep them handy as you consider where to live.
Workspace.rateLimited: The provider is rate limiting requests. Wait before retrying.
Workspace.providerUnavailable: The service provider is unavailable. Try again later.
Workspace.accessRequired: Active service access is required. Check your access or payment.
Workspace.requestConflict: This attempt is used, expired, or needs reconciliation. Verify it before creating another.
Workspace.environmentUnavailable: Personal features require the configured development or isolated staging deployment.
Workspace.invalidRequest: The request is invalid or prerequisites are missing. Review the inputs and retry.
